_meta.caveat: Not copied from one official list. Names and parents follow the Constitution of Kenya 2010 and well-known statutes; the ministry list changes with each Executive Order, so every ministry row carries confidence 'medium' and must be checked against the current Executive Order before being relied on. Bodies marked 'low' are included only so the registry has a place for them and have not been confirmed.
_meta.extensionNote: Version 2 adds scope (required on every institution), state departments, state corporations, regulators, tribunals, funds and public universities, offices with cardinality, appointing authority, term and legal basis, headquarters expectations, and a short list of national facilities. All new rows are custom-prepared from manual research by a coding agent (Claude) from general knowledge of the Constitution of Kenya 2010, the State Corporations Act, the Public Finance Management Act and well-known statutes. Appointing authorities and board sizes follow the usual statutory pattern and carry the confidence of the row; none is copied from one official list, and every body must be checked against its establishing instrument and the current Executive Order before being relied on.
